statement_html:
Développer et réduire l'expression \(\left(11 y + 10\right) \left(7 - 12 y\right)\).

Je développe :

\(\left(11 y + 10\right) \left(7 - 12 y\right) =\) .
solution_html:
\((\color{red} 11 y \color{blue} + 10)(\color{green} 7 \color{purple} - 12 y)\) = \(\color{red}( 11 y )\color{black}\times \color{green}( 7 )\) + \(\color{red}( 11 y )\color{black} \times \color{purple}( - 12 y )\) + \(\color{blue}( 10 )\color{black} \times \color{green}( 7 )\) + \(\color{blue}( 10 )\color{black} \times \color{purple}( - 12 y )\)
= \(77 y\) + \(\left(- 132 y^{2}\right)\) + \(70\) + \(\left(- 120 y\right)\)
= \(- 132 y^{2} - 43 y + 70\)
